utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the carpool tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I can still do it. See you in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’ll be ready at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I can help with the carpool if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus. I might take you up on that if I get mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, just give me a shout if you want me to sort out the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and see what’s up with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, just let me know if the timing works out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check and let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: How about 8:15? That gives us a little buffer before we need to leave.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 8:15 works for me. I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure, I can spread the word and see who wants in on the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll start asking around and see who can join in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’ve got the carpool list handy, so let’s make sure your pickup time is set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, what time am I set for?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You’re set for 8:15 this morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send me the carpool details again? I want to make sure I have the pickup time right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I’ll send it again in a sec. Pickup’s at 8:15.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, got it - 8:15 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take next Tuesday afternoon, if that helps. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Tuesday afternoon works for me. Would 2:30 be okay?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 2:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I only heard a little second-hand, but I’m happy to follow along. What’s the latest on the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard there’s a draft carpool schedule going around, and I’m checking who still needs a ride. I can fill you in once I confirm the last couple of spots.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps. Let me know when the last spots are confirmed, and I’ll follow the draft.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you're handling the carpool, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: How about around 7:30? I might be a little fuzzy on the exact time, but that should work.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 works for me. If you settle on it, just let me know and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can do the carpool again. Just tell me the time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, what time should I tell everyone?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’d tell everyone 8:00 sharp.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can help with the carpool. I’ll check my route and let you know what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. Let me know what you can take, and I’ll fill in the rest.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll check my route and send you what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool. I might need a quick reminder on the pickup time, but I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I think the pickup time is still the same as we planned. I’ll remind you if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll plan on the same pickup time unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the carpool. What changed again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The pickup time changed. I can text you the new one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, text me the new pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli. I can help with the carpool if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: could you take the Tuesday pickup, and I’ll handle the rest?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Tuesday pickup is on me. I’ll keep it simple and be there for it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can take the early shift for the carpool if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks. I’ll let the others know we’ve got the early shift covered.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, I’ll be there for the early shift.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can ask around and help line up the carpool if that makes things easier.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would help a lot, thanks. I just need to know which address you end up with so I can keep track.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll grab the address and let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the carpool list organized, Cleo. What time works best for your pickup?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mid-morning works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll put you down for a mid-morning pickup and share the finalized carpool plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a change, but I’m probably missing the latest. What’s the plan for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s at my place now; I can pick you up at 7:15 and we’ll head out together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, 7:15 at your place. Thanks for the update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can take a carpool spot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thank you. I’ll send over the pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, send them over and I’ll check my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take the morning pickup if that helps. Just let me know the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What time are you thinking, and where should I meet you?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: How about 8:00 a.m. at the front entrance?
